activity_b.text: Good morning, please have a seat.
I’m Ms. Perera, the food processing training supervisor.
How are you feeling today?
Good morning, madam. I’m doing well, thank you.
I’m a bit nervous, but I’m ready to do my best.
That’s completely fine.
This is a friendly interview.
So, Nadee, I see you finished school last year.
Can you tell me a little about your background?
Yes, madam. I completed my A/Ls in August.
During my final year, I worked part-time at a small food production unit in Matale.
I don’t have a lot of experience yet, but I can manage basic food processing tasks carefully.
Good.
What kind of work did you support at the production unit?
I assisted the senior operator with preparing ingredients, sanitising work surfaces, and measuring batches for mixing.
I also helped operate the small dough mixer and sometimes monitored temperature levels during heating.
When the unit became busy, I labelled containers and checked packaging for quality issues.
I wasn’t responsible for major operations, but I always supported the team whenever they needed help.
Excellent.
What skills do you think you can contribute to our training programme?
I can check food temperatures accurately, madam.
I know how to portion mixtures correctly, and I recently started learning how to adjust the steam kettle settings.
I also learnt how to stay calm when production targets are tight.
I might need some guidance with calibration of weighing scales and completing full quality-control forms, but I’m going to improve quickly.
That’s a positive mindset.
How comfortable are you with basic hygiene procedures and equipment handling?
I’m not fully confident yet, but I can already follow simple hygiene routines and operate small-scale equipment safely.
I might take more time with large industrial mixers and advanced pasteurising machines.
That’s understandable.
What are your plans for the next few years?
I’m going to complete this training programme and then apply for an apprenticeship.
I might also follow short food safety courses to strengthen my technical skills.
Very good.
Thank you, Nadee. We’ll contact you soon.
Thank you very much, madam. I appreciate the opportunity.
